test.create_query: CREATE TABLE t_prewhere_json (id UInt64, j JSON(max_dynamic_paths = 0)) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY id
CREATE TABLE t_prewhere_map (id UInt64, m Map(String, String)) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY id
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO t_prewhere_json SELECT number, concat('{{"kind":"a","n":', toString(number), ',"payload":"', repeat('x', 2000), '"}}') FROM numbers_mt(3000000)
INSERT INTO t_prewhere_map SELECT number, mapFromArrays(arrayMap(i -> 'k' || toString(i), range(16)), arrayMap(i -> repeat('v', 60), range(16))) FROM numbers_mt(10000000)
test.query: SELECT count() FROM t_prewhere_json WHERE j.kind = 'b' AND length(toString(j)) > 10
SELECT count() FROM t_prewhere_json WHERE j.kind = 'b' AND length(toString(j.payload)) > 10
SELECT count() FROM t_prewhere_map WHERE length(m) = 3 AND m['k1'] != ''
